UK address for the summer: Flat 3, 22 Clifton Vale, Bristol BS8 4PN, United Kingdom; mobile +44 7700 900174. Her mother, Mrs. Margaret Ellison, is the host. 2. Copy of the dental letter sent to school nurse Beverley Hatch at Maplewood Elementary School. 3. Sent immunization summary to Clifton Park Surgery Bristol (fax +44 117 496 0102) for the UK visit, release form ROI-2092-0618 signed. 4. Dad Sung-ho Park to pick up an extra inhaler? NO - not asthmatic, ignore the last copy-forward line "Theo uses Ventolin" (that is Emmeline Vo, DOB 09/11/2086).
